case: Elmer McCurdy, the Outlaw Mummy (1976 discovery, Long Beach, California)
angle: A 1911 outlaw's corpse was mummified, sold to a carnival, and ended up as a funhouse prop at an amusement park—where in 1976 a crew member bent the arm to move it and a real human bone snapped, revealing it had been a dead body on public display for 65 years.
